```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Pipeliene:

1. From panaroo pangenome analysis use roary like output that contain gene family to gene id mapping, to create 
gene_family file for each corresponding gene ids in that family, output file would be named by panaroo family_id 
and each gene_ids would be in each line. Will create 17k file for RSSC
```{bash}

cat gene_presence_absence_roary.csv | awk 'NR>1' | cut -d, -f 1 | while read family; 
  do 
  
    echo "----$family------"; 
    cat gene_presence_absence_roary.csv | grep -w "$family" | cut -d, -f 15- | sed 's/,/\n/g' >
      gene_families/"$family.list"
      
  done

```

2. Concatenate all the BAKTA annotated proteins sequences from the whole set of strains/isolates 
```{bash}

cat "../../../../Metadata/RSSC_strains.tsv" | while read line; 
  do 
    echo $line; 
    cat "../../../Annotation/Ralstonia-159-complete-BAKTA/${line}_BAKTA/${line}.faa" \
    >> rssc_proteins/rssc_proteins.fa;
  done

```

3. Use the `seqtk subseq` command to get proteins for each gene family using gene_family to gene_id mapping file and 
the protein fasta file. 

```{bash}

# seqtk subseq rssc_proteins/rssc_proteins.fa gene_families/tsf.list | less -S
for i in gene_families/*;
  do 
    filename=$(basename "$i" | sed 's/~/_/g');
    seqtk subseq rssc_proteins/rssc_proteins.fa "$i" \
      > "rssc_pan_genefam_proteins/$filename.fa";
  done

```


4. Then align each fasta file corresponding to each gene families

```{bash}
# An alias for an accurate option (L-INS-i) for an alignment of up to ∼200 sequences × ∼2,000 sites
# mafft-linsi {input} > {output}


for i in rssc_pan_genefam_proteins/*.fa;
  do 
    outfile=$(basename "$i" | cut -d "." -f -2); 
    mafft-linsi "$i" > "rssc_pan_genefam_alignments/${outfile}.aln"; 
    echo "Alignment done for: $outfile";
  done

```

5. Then run PAL2NAL for codon based alignments

```{python}

rule remove_duplicates:
    input:
        aln=os.path.join(config['RESULTS'], "DNDS", "PAL2NAL", "{genefamily}.codon.fa"),
    output:
        aln_unique=os.path.join(config['RESULTS'], "DNDS", "PAL2NAL_DEDUP", "{genefamily}.codon.dedup.fa"),
    conda:
        "../envs/hyphy.yaml",
    shell:
        """
            seqkit rmdup -s {input.aln} -o {output.aln_unique}
        """

rule faToaxt:
    input: 
        os.path.join(config['RESULTS'], "DNDS", "PAL2NAL_DEDUP", "{genefamily}.codon.dedup.fa"),
    output:
        os.path.join(config['RESULTS'], "DNDS", "PAL2NAL_DEDUP_AXT", "{genefamily}.codon.dedup.axt"),
    params:
        prefix=os.path.join(config['RESULTS'], "DNDS", "PAL2NAL_DEDUP_AXT", "{genefamily}.codon.dedup"),
    shell:
        "perl scripts/parseFastaIntoAXT.pl {input} {params.prefix}"

rule kaks2:
    input:
        os.path.join(config['RESULTS'], "DNDS", "PAL2NAL_DEDUP_AXT", "{genefamily}.codon.dedup.axt"),
    output:
        os.path.join(config['RESULTS'], "DNDS", "PAL2NAL_DEDUP_KAKS", "{genefamily}.kaks.tsv"),
    params:
        codon="11",
        method="NG"
    conda:
        "../envs/kaks2.yaml",
    shell:
        """
            KaKs_Calculator -i {input} -o {output} -c {params.codon} -m {params.method}
        """
```
